data.title: 霍尔海雅 · 展柜前的耳机
data.description: 讲解音频讲到一种早已失传的仪式时，她摘下一边耳机，低声指出说明牌上的年代或许还值得商榷。
data.action: 听展览讲解并注视展品
data.promptProse: Inside a quiet historical museum gallery, Ho'olheyak stands beside a tall glass display case housing a weathered carved ritual artifact and a small brass placard. She lifts one audio-guide headphone cup slightly away from her ear and glances toward her companion with a knowing, amused smile, her loose dark coat and black dress catching the soft gallery glow. Focused overhead spotlights illuminate the relic inside the vitrine and cast faint glass reflections across her grey hair and feathered head wings.
data.animaCaption: Standing beside the illuminated glass museum vitrine in her loose dark coat and black dress, Ho'olheyak slips one headphone cup away from her ear and turns with an amused, knowing smile toward the viewer. Warm display spotlights highlight the ancient carved artifact inside the case and catch soft reflections along the glass.
